scope: Authored uncalibrated relative weights for a Swiss/Alpine forest experiment. Height thresholds and abundances are design choices, not measurements copied from botanical sources. Not a global climate/soil/habitat model or morphology acceptance.
height_convention: Height of the existing terrain contact in the scene's WGS84/provider convention; no geoid conversion asserted.

species.name: Quercus robur
species.reference_fact: Swiss forest species primarily associated with lower elevation belts.

species.name: Fagus sylvatica
species.reference_fact: Swiss forests spanning lower to montane belts and locally subalpine conditions.

species.name: Picea abies
species.reference_fact: Swiss montane and subalpine forest species; low Swiss Plateau occurrences are not all native.

species.name: Pinus sylvestris
species.reference_fact: Forest, rocky/alluvial sites and pioneer growth on nutrient-poor soils across lower to subalpine belts; soil/moisture response is not modelled here.

species.name: Pinus cembra
species.reference_fact: Alpine/Carpathian mountain tree, chiefly subalpine, with occasional alpine occurrence.

species.name: Larix decidua
species.reference_fact: Subalpine forests in Switzerland; planted occurrences in lower regions do not provide a natural-range model.

distribution_reference: Deussen et al., SIGGRAPH1998, distribution and shared plant models as separate stages; doc/references/vegetation/siggraph/1998-plant-ecosystems.pdf, pages3/4 previously opened.
